stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one

    cnt=Counter(c for c,size,_ in cs)
    uniq=[x for x in cs if cnt[x[0]]==1]
    if len(uniq)>=2:
        uniq.sort(key=lambda t:t[1], reverse=True)
        a,b=uniq[0],uniq[1]
        for r,cx in b[2]: g[r][cx]=a[0]
    return g

def f(g):
    cs,bg=compslist(g,None)
    cnt=Counter(c for c,sz,cl in cs)
    singles=[c for c in cnt if cnt[c]==1 and c!=bg]
    tgt=max(singles,key=lambda c:max(sz for c_,sz,cl in cs if c_==c))
    grp=defaultdict(list)
    for c,sz,cl in cs: grp[nshape(cl)].append((c,sz,cl))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for sh,tup in grp.items():
        if len(tup)!=2: continue
        a,b=tup
        box_a=box(a[2]); box_b=box(b[2])
        d_a=abs(box_a[1]-tgt[1])+abs(box_a[3]-tgt[3])
        d_b=abs(box_b[1]-tgt[1])+abs(box_b[3]-tgt[3])
        far=(a if d_a>=d_b else b)
        for i,j in far[2]: out[i][j]=tgt
    return out

        def boxof(t): return box(t[2])

            # nearest other comp bbox (non-group) via center manhattan

            for o_ in cs:

                bb=box(o_[2]); ca,cx,ccx,ccy=bb

# Candidate B: recolor member of dup group far from largest-unique-target comp, to target color. Check all demos.
def f(g):
    cs,bg=compslist(g,None)
    cnt=Counter(c for c,_ in cs)
    tgt=max((c,cl) for c,cl in cs if cnt[c]==1)
    grp=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cl in cs: grp[nshape(cl)].append((c,cl))
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    ca=centroid(tgt[1])
    for sh,tup in grp.items():
        if len(tup)!=2 or tup not in [grp[sh]]: pass
        a,b=tup
        da=sum(abs(p[0]-ca[0])+abs(p[1]-ca[1]) for p in a[1])/len(a[1])
        db=sum(abs(p[0]-ca[0])+abs(p[1]-ca[1]) for p in b[1])/len(b[1])
        far=(a if da>=db else b)
        for i,j in far[1]: out[i][j]=tgt[0]
    return out

ok=True
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3','Demo pair 4']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; oi=G[k+' output']
    fo=f(gi)
    m=fo==oi; print(k,'match:',m); ok=m and ok
    if not m:

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def compslist(g,bg=None):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                c=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==c:
                            seen[x][y]=True; st.append((x,y))
                out.append((c,cells))
    return out,bg
def nshape(cells):
    r0=min(p[0] for p in cells); c0=min(p[1] for p in cells)
    return tuple(sorted((p[0]-r0,p[1]-c0) for p in cells))
def dist_cells(a,b): return min(abs(i-i2)+abs(j-j2) for i,j in a for i2,j2 in b)

def f(g, mode='unique'):
    cs,bg=compslist(g,None)
    grp=defaultdict(list)
    for c,cl in cs: grp[nshape(cl)].append((c,cl))
    uniq=max((c,len(cl) for c,cl in cs),key=lambda x:(x[1],-x[0]))
    # find largest comp with unique color
    best=(max(len(cl) for c,cl in cs if len({c for cc,_ in cs if cc==c})==1 if False else 0,0,0))
    def is_uc(c): return sum(1 for cc,_ in cs if cc==c)==1
    cand=[(c,cl) for c,cl in cs if is_uc(c)]
    tgt=max(cand,key=lambda t:len(t[1])) if cand else None
    ref=tgt
    out=[row[:] for row in g]

        ca=(sum(p[0] for p in a[1])/len(a[1]),sum(p[1] for p in a[1])/len(a[1]))
        cb=(sum(p[0] for p in b[1])/len(b[1]),sum(p[1] for b[1]))
        tc=(sum(p[0] for p in tgt[1])/len(tgt[1]),sum(p[1] for p in tgt[1])/len(tgt[1]))
        da=abs(ca[0]-tc[0])+abs(ca[1]-tc[1])

        recolor=(a if da>=db else b)

from itertools import combinations
def solve(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    cs,bg=compslist(g)
    grp=defaultdict(list)
    for c_ in cs: grp[ns(c_['cl'])].append(c_)
    # find ALL groups with >1 member; count distinct colors
    multi=[(sh,tup) for sh,tup in grp.items() if len(tup)>1]
    if len(multi)!=1: return None
    sh,tup=multi[0]
    changed=None
    for m1,m2 in combinations(tup,2):
        if m1['c']!=m2['c']:
            changed=m1 if False else m1
            break
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for comp in cs:
        if comp in [changed]:
            for i,j in comp['cl']:
                out[i][j]=tup[1-tup.index(comp)]['c']
        # also ensure the OTHER stays its own
    return out

import os,glob,re,json
from collections import Counter,defaultdict
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def compslist(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); bg=Counter(x for row in g for x in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]; out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j]!=bg and not seen[i][j]:
                c=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; cl=set()
                while st:
                    a,b=st.pop(); cl.add((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<H and 0<=y<W and not seen[x][y] and g[x][y]==c:
                            seen[x][y]=True; st.append((x,y))
                out.append({'c':c,'cl':set(cl)})
    return out,bg
